The bug: check-then-act race. `Agent.get` and `Agent.update` are two separate round trips, so concurrent callers can both read a value below limit and both increment, exceeding the cap.

Fix: do the check-and-increment atomically inside a single Agent operation — `Agent.get_and_update`. Minimal change:

```elixir
def allow?(counter, limit) do
  Agent.get_and_update(counter, fn count ->
    if count < limit do
      {true, count + 1}
    else
      {false, count}
    end
  end)
end
```

That keeps the public API identical (start/0, allow?/2), uses the same Agent, minimal diff. The timeout defaults are fine (Agent.get_and_update has 5000ms default).
